content.title: Park Inventory and Amenities
content.summary: Arvada has an extensive parks and trails network, featuring over 100 parks and 150 miles of trails across 4,200 acres, with 96% of residents living within a 10-minute walk of a park. The city offers a variety of park types, including community, regional, special use parks, and athletic complexes, each equipped with diverse amenities. An interactive map is available for residents to explore the specific features of each park.
content.body:
The City of Arvada boasts a robust parks, trails and open space network that includes more than 100 park sites and 150 miles of trail covering 4,200 acres.

Included on this page:

- Community and Regional Parks
- Athletic Complexes
- Special Use Parks
- Neighborhood Parks
- Trails and Open Spaces
- Golf Courses

Did you know that 96% of Arvada residents live within a 10-minute walk of a park? That's one of the highest rates of park access in the country! The City is home to more than 100 parks, ranging from neighborhood and community parks to regional parks and athletic complexes.

Check out the amenities available at each park by using the interactive map or the alphabetical list of parks below the map. [View the map in a separate window](https://arvada.maps.arcgis.com/apps/instant/sidebar/index.html?appid=b0199c652f7447338b3759ff63f61882).
